primary.description: Brand navy. Body text, display type, solid surfaces, borders

accent.description: Brand olive. Large text (24px+), fills, rules, and focus rings on paper. Never small text

accent-soft.description: Lightened olive for focus rings and small accents on navy surfaces

paper.description: Page background, a cool off-white that sits with navy

muted.description: Secondary text and labels, a navy-tinted gray

mid.description: Risk 40 to 69. Burnt orange, kept well away from the olive accent

low.description: Risk below 40. Teal, kept away from both olive and navy

_note: Source of truth for design tokens. Mirror changes in src/index.css @theme. Run npm run contrast after any color change.
